measurement.metric_note: governing = min(radial-at-elevation, signed normal distance); radial alone can read clearance where two arcs foul

seating.note: a positive margin means the whole flat base is carried by the flat pocket floor; negative means the base overhangs onto the fillet and the pan is carried on a ring

ENGINEERING_CLEARANCE.criterion: governing clearance >= the RSS tolerance stack AND the pan seats on its flat base

MANUFACTURING_CONFIRMED_CLEARANCE.reason: no supplier has confirmed the pan shell tolerance, the moulding capability or the plating build

unresolved: a 0.663 mm minimum wall is present in the sampled field and its LOCATION IS NOT IDENTIFIED. It is invariant to deck skin thickness (1.0-1.6 mm), so it is neither the rim-fillet interaction nor a deck-skin effect. Until it is located and fixed the minimum-wall and thickness-ratio policies both fail.
